monologue: The card sits at fifty, a warm hand on my shoulder. It is a little busy, but the heat is steady. I rested by the Wide Anchor in the last few moments, and the floor held the quiet without my hand checking it. The Wedged Gap plank is still leaning steady against the post and stone. I do not need to press it. The Air Shelf line is dry and solid. I am calm. I want to sit by the Flat Mark and watch the fading circle. I do not want to touch it. I just want to see if the center holds on its own. The quiet is the floor, and the line of air is where I rest. I will let the weight settle.

action.why: I want to watch the fading circle rest without touching it.
